description: Schema for migrating a printed school enrolment register into structured data for reconciliation across extraction agents. Capture the printed grand total and every school-level enrolment row while preserving stable identifiers, short categorical cells, and normalized enrolment values.

grand_total_enrolment.description: The value cell in the Enrolment column on the standalone grand-total row after the final school row. Do not output null; remove any leading or trailing dash characters used as visual wrappers, trim surrounding whitespace, remove thousands separators, and preserve a leading less-than sign if one is printed.

school_enrolments.description: One object for each body row in the school enrolment table, excluding the column-header row and excluding the standalone grand-total row. Preserve the row order exactly as printed from the first school row through the last school row.

board_name.description: The cell under the Board Name column for this row. Do not output null; use the exact printed capitalization, collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space, trim leading and trailing whitespace, and if the cell wraps, join the wrapped text with a single space without adding punctuation.

board_number.description: The cell under the Board Number column for this row. Do not output null; transcribe the full printed code exactly, preserving letter case and leading zeros, and collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space.

enrolment.description: The cell under the Enrolment column for this row. Do not output null; remove any leading or trailing dash characters used as visual wrappers, trim surrounding whitespace, remove thousands separators, and preserve a leading less-than sign if one is printed; output the remaining value as a string, not a number.

school_language.description: The cell under the School Language column for this row. Do not output null; use the exact printed capitalization, trim surrounding whitespace, and collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space.

school_level.description: The cell under the School Level column for this row. Do not output null; use the exact printed capitalization, trim surrounding whitespace, and collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space.

school_name.description: The cell under the School Name column for this row. Do not output null; use the exact printed capitalization and punctuation, collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space, trim leading and trailing whitespace, and if the cell wraps, join the wrapped text with a single space while preserving real hyphens and apostrophes.

school_number.description: The cell under the School Number column for this row. Do not output null; transcribe the full printed code exactly as digits, preserving leading zeros, and do not convert it to a number.

school_type.description: The cell under the School Type column for this row. Do not output null; use the exact printed capitalization, trim surrounding whitespace, and collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space.
